items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I was on the Spike Lee record date, it was “Jungle Fever” or it was “No More Some Blues.”

ctx.x: Was it partly volume and partly just the physical limitations of the instruments that you couldn’t walk all night?
I don’t know. I don’t really know. I was on the Spike Lee record date, it was “Jungle Fever” or it was “No More Some Blues.”
